class BankTransactionFilterSet(django_filters.FilterSet):
    account_id = django_filters.NumberFilter(field_name='bank_account__id')
    min_amount = django_filters.NumberFilter(field_name='amount', lookup_expr='gte')

    class Meta:
        model = BankTransaction
        fields = ['account_id', 'min_amount']

class BankTransactionListView(generics.ListAPIView):
    queryset = BankTransaction.objects.all()
    serializer_class = TransactionSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_class = BankTransactionFilterSet
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
diagnosis: BankTransactionListView declares queryset = BankTransaction.objects.all() and relies on BankTransactionFilterSet. The filterset exposes account_id filtering on the foreign key relation without restricting the base queryset to the requesting user's bank accounts, letting any authenticated user view transaction histories of other users.
